sources.source_name: Belfast City Council Planning Committee agenda items, minutes, reports and public document packs
sources.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council committee pages and Planning Portal content are subject to website copyright/terms; this scratch pack stores factual metadata, short paraphrases and source URLs only pending reuse review.
sources.attribution_requirements: Attribute Belfast City Council Planning Committee; where a record is reconciled to the Planning Portal, also attribute Northern Ireland Planning Portal and Belfast City Council as planning authority.
sources.coverage_years: Committee archive records mainly from 2015 onward, with some older/current committee report PDFs and agenda pages. This pack retained records dated 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19 where a Belfast point could be assigned at least approximately.
sources.update_frequency: Committee archive updates as agendas, reports, minutes and document packs are published; historic pages can be amended or moved.
sources.geographic_scope: Belfast City Council planning authority area.
sources.granularity: Application/agenda-item level: application reference, site label, proposal summary, meeting date, committee action where visible, supporting report/document URL.
key_fields_for_events: committee minute or recommendation where visible
sources.geometry_fields: Most committee pages provide addresses/site labels but not reusable GIS geometry. Coordinates in candidates are approximate review points; production import should prefer Planning Portal polygons or case-report site plans where permitted.
sources.reliability: strong for committee/public-record existence and meeting-date milestones; moderate for proposal summary when extracted from agenda snippets; weak for exact geometry unless a named address is clear.
required_caveats: Planning Committee consideration, recommendation, approval, refusal, deferral, site visit, or report publication is not evidence of construction, completion, occupation or opening.
Proposal text describes what was applied for or considered, not delivered change.
Some agenda-page snippets truncate site labels; those records are marked inferred/coarse and require Planning Portal reconciliation before import.
Committee approval date may differ from final decision-notice date on the Planning Portal.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use high-confidence records as planning/committee milestone events only. Before production import, reconcile each source_record_id to the NI Planning Portal application page and polygon, preserve linked F/LBC/DCA/RM references, and drop any coarse geometry records that cannot be verified.

duplicate_screen.method: Application/source record IDs were compared manually and by local text search against round123_belfast_planning_portal_committee_more, round124_belfast_planning_appeals_dfc_public_realm, round125_belfast_civic_public_realm_geocoded, and round125_belfast_geocode_previous_rejects.
